content.short: Lumiterra is an open-world survival crafting MMORPG on Ronin featuring a DeFi-integrated in-game economy and taming.
content.description: Lumiterra is a cross-platform, open-world survival crafting MMORPG built natively on the Ronin network. The game blends high-action combat, intricate farming, and complex gathering mechanics within a vast, beautifully realized world. Players can tame mysterious creatures, craft powerful equipment, and collaborate with friends to explore and conquer challenging environments. Unlike traditional titles, Lumiterra features a deep DeFi-integrated economy where in-game resources and assets have real-world value. By leveraging the high throughput and low fees of the Ronin blockchain, Lumiterra provides a seamless gaming experience.
